title: The Watcher in the Trees
text: Someone has been following since dawn, never close, always at the edge of the trees. Only one of you has seen them clearly: a tall, still shape, watching. They seem to want that one.

options.label: The one they watch goes alone to meet them.

outcomes.text: It is an old hunter, offering a lesson in trade for a story.

options.label: The craftiest sets an ambush to turn the watcher into the watched.

outcomes.text: You catch them. They are not pleased.

options.label: Keep walking; if they wanted a fight, they would have had one.

outcomes.text: They follow you all the way to the next fight, and watch it.
